resources.string: Supports: VLESS (Reality/TLS/WS/gRPC/xHTTP + PQC encryption) • VMess • Trojan • Shadowsocks • Hysteria2 (native client + Salamander/Gecko) • SSR • TUIC • ShadowTLS • AnyTLS • SNIc (parsed; some may not be in the Xray core)
When the switch below is ON, this name is added to every working server so you can recognize your own configs. It is saved automatically.
Add channel name to working servers
How many servers are tested at the same time. Recommended: 5 — faster, without overheating the phone.
How long to wait for each server. If it does not answer in time it is marked ❌, but the rest of the test keeps running.
Beta on: always downloads the newest release (even pre-release). Beta off: newest stable only. On devices that block core updates, the app opens the releases page.

v1.0.40 • Fixed: deadTunnel categorization completely eliminated — no false dead tunnel reports • Fixed: atomic dynamic port allocation with OS ServerSocket fallback and worker port recycling • Improved: direct alignment of GeoIP client timeouts with user-configured timeout
v1.0.39 • Fixed: false deadTunnel categorization removed — API errors no longer cause working proxies to be marked as dead • Fixed: atomic dynamic port allocation per worker with automatic OS fallback (no port exhaustion or collisions) • Improved: full parallel GeoIP query without artificial wave cutoffs for maximum accuracy and speed
v1.0.38 • Fixed: TCP fragmentation settings mapping for Xray freedom outbound (under fragment key) so TLS SNI bypass works properly • Fixed: Clean output names without duplicate counter numbers (e.g. 🇩🇪 Germany | Channel) • Fixed: Scan progress freeze bug on early engine exit or connection failure • Fixed: Option to exclude unknown country configs now properly filters copied links • Fixed: VMess renaming now updates the internal JSON "ps" field for full client compatibility • Fixed: GeoChecker reliability improvements, api.country.is parsing and browser User-Agent header • Improvement: Test summary report card remains visible after scan completion
v1.0.37 • Fixed: configs pasted from web pages / other bots with HTML entities (&) were mis-parsed — e.g. hy2 Salamander links lost their obfs password and failed. Entities are now unescaped before parsing
v1.0.36 • Fixed: the duplicate-name counter no longer appears AFTER the channel name — it now sits on the flag/country part (e.g. “🇩🇪 Germany 2 | Wpnfa”) and nameless unknown servers get “unknown” so the channel name stays clean
v1.0.35 • Fixed: server IP (host:port) no longer appears in output names — duplicate labels now get a simple number (2, 3…) instead
v1.0.34 • Servers without a detected country keep their ORIGINAL name — no more ⚠ warning in the name or the flag strip • Output names are now unique within a run (colliding labels get the server’s host:port), so “duplicate client” importers can no longer delete different servers that share a label • Slow exits that answered nothing within the 30s budget (pure timeouts, no resets) get one final 20s geo attempt — fewer false “country unknown” results
v1.0.33 • Fixed: the plain-HTTP geo fallback (ip-api) was blocked by Android’s cleartext policy on every request — cleartext is now permitted for that single domain only, so the fallback actually works on device
v1.0.31 • Fixed: port collisions between servers in the same run (two servers could grab the same port and one failed to bind, showing a false “unreachable”) • Fixed: starting a run with a big list could freeze the screen (ANR) — engine version checks and port probing now run in the background • Fixed: vmess+gRPC links where the panel puts the service name in “path” now work • Fixed: leaked worker threads after each finished run • New: Hysteria v1 links are reported with a clear message instead of being mis-parsed; unbracketed IPv6 addresses no longer break host/port parsing • Cleaner: dead geo sources removed, country.is now part of the second wave; results box updates are debounced
v1.0.30 • New: TCP fragment support — the fm= field (tlshello, lengths, delays) is now applied to the dial; servers that dropped TLS hellos (mostly the 188.114.97.x cloudflare-style ones) should now connect • New: ECH support for links with ech= (xray force-query) • New: a fast lone-request probe before the geo check — an exit that instantly resets the traffic is now reported as “unreachable” instead of burning the whole geo budget as “country unknown”
v1.0.29 • Full advanced-xhttp support: mode (auto / stream-one), ALPN, and the panel extra JSON (headers, xmux, xPadding obfuscation) are now mapped into the Xray config — servers that previously only half-connected (e.g. b2n.ir) now connect fully • New: a connected server whose country could not be detected is no longer a hard fail — it stays in the results with a ⚠️ mark (link is copyable, country unknown)
v1.0.28 • Hardened country detection even more: geo probes are now sent as small bursts with short pauses, ending with two single sequential requests — the pattern flaky exits tolerate, so far more “country unknown” servers should now get labeled
v1.0.27 • New option in the Caption tab: include “country unknown” servers in Copy links only — a server that connected but couldn’t be labeled is usually still a working proxy, so its link is no longer lost
v1.0.26 • New: “Copy links only” button — copies just the working config links (unique) to the clipboard, so pasting into your client imports exactly the working servers; failed lines are not links, that’s why fewer servers showed up in the client before
v1.0.25 • Fixed: servers that dropped the first geo probe are now retried in 3 rounds of geo sources — “country unknown” on flaky exits should be much rarer • New: if the engine log shows a real error, the server is now reported as “unreachable” instead of “country unknown” • Note: a few servers accept the connection but only forward traffic for certain client IPs (mostly non-Iran) — those will still show “country unknown” on your phone because the exit blocks the phone’s IP; they only work for other users
v1.0.24 • New: end-of-run report in the results — ok / no country / unreachable / skipped counts • Hardened country detection: 2 more robust geo sources (Cloudflare trace + ipinfo), and the geo time budget is now at least 30s — slow exits that showed "country unknown" before should now resolve • New: a short light vibration when the run reaches 100% • Note: your country emoji codes are stored in the app data and survive updates (only uninstalling removes them — use the Backup button)
v1.0.23 • Fixed: the screen no longer jumps to a fixed position while a test run is in progress — wherever you scroll, it stays put • New: a progress notification with a live percentage while scanning, so you can follow the run even when the app is in the background (you are asked once for the notification permission on Android 13+)
v1.0.22 • Country flags in the results strip no longer repeat — each country appears once, even with multiple servers from it (the emoji-code box was already unique) • The app update button now uses the same bright filled style as the core update button
v1.0.21 • Hardened: GeoChecker now uses a CompletionService — the fastest-answering service is used immediately instead of waiting in order • Hardened: IPv6 host/port parsing (bracketed, bare-with-port and portless forms) • Hardened: core update — the downloaded zip SHA-256 is logged, the installed version must match the release tag, the replace is atomic, and core update/test are locked while a run is active (and Run is locked during an update) • Hardened: query values keep a literal plus sign (no more + → space), Stop can no longer trigger a fake finish, AppLog only reads the log tail
v1.0.20 • New: output language for country names — Persian or English (shown after the flag in results; the channel suffix order is unchanged) • Country code list in the Caption tab is now collapsible (tap the row to open/close) • Livelier test animation: deeper water with a gradient, drifting wave layers, rising bubbles and a glow pulse, smoother percentage
v1.0.19 • New: dedicated Caption tab — country code list (flag + name, searchable), premium-code dialog, and backup/restore for your code list • New: editable caption template (the {{FLAGS}} placeholder is replaced with the flag codes from the last run) • New: one-tap final caption — flag codes in [123456]… format plus your full template, ready to copy into the channel post • Countries without a code are listed under Latest run — tap to set the code and the caption updates instantly, no re-test needed
v1.0.18 • New: country premium-emoji codes — set the animated flag-emoji code for each country in Settings (tap the flag) • New: third output box under the results — after a run it lists the emoji codes of the countries it found, one code per line, ready to paste into your channel caption (tap to copy)
v1.0.17 • FIXED (crash): in-app update crash on Android 12+ — the REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission is declared again and the install-permission check is now crash-proof • FIXED: Hysteria2 links that cannot be tested no longer leave the run stuck on "Running"" when they are the only configs • FIXED: TUIC links in the common uuid:password@host form are now parsed correctly • FIXED: AnyTLS links — the auth part is now treated as the password (official format) • Fixed: exported link names are URL-safe (spaces encoded) so all clients parse them • Fixed: flag strip is now thread-safe; Stop kills running engines immediately; rotation no longer recreates the app mid-run • Geo results now show vote count in the log (single-answer = low confidence) • Log file rotation: app.log capped at 1 MB, old engine logs cleaned up
v1.0.16
• Fixed: the Log dialog now reloads the previous session from disk — a crash is visible in the Log after a restart (with version + full stack trace)
• In-app app update hardened: crash-proof order, direct crash-to-file write, null-safe storage path
• Fixed: the tab you were on (e.g. Settings) is now reliably restored after a language/theme switch

v1.0.15
• Clearer result message when a link is parsed but its protocol is not supported by the current Xray core

v1.0.14
• App identity changed: all channel traces were removed from the package name and the signing certificate — for THIS version uninstall the old app first; future updates install over it
• Fixed: changing the language keeps you on the Settings tab (it no longer jumps back to the test page)
• Fixed: Appearance rows no longer stick together in Persian; long button labels shortened so the option boxes stay uniform
• In-app app update hardened: crashes are now written to the app log (Log button) and the installer has a fallback through the public Downloads folder
• Removed dead code

v1.0.13
• Core update: the downloaded package is now kept — after a failed install it continues from the cache (no re-download); it is deleted only after a successful install
• Core update: a live progress bar with percentage right under the core version, and the same for the app update
• Core update: never downgrades — if the current core is newer, it says so instead of replacing it
• Core update: extra install routes tried before giving up; if the device still blocks it, a clear dialog offers the app update (new app versions ship the new core built in)
• New: the app now ships Xray 26.7.28 (previously 26.3.27)
• Appearance: Language and Theme are now two tap-to-expand rows with their options inside
• New: a small box under the results with just the exit flags (tap it to copy)

v1.0.12
• Fixed: the core update bug — the downloaded package was never unzipped (that is why the update always failed)
• Core update now shows live progress (percent + size) and retries once on network hiccups
• Less Play Protect nagging: the app no longer declares the install permission; it asks for it only when you actually use the in-app update
• Much glassier theme: panels are more transparent over a deeper gradient, cleaner color palette in light & dark mode
• New app icon: a scanner radar — what the app actually does

v1.0.11
• Settings: Xray core update moved to Settings — one Update button + beta tick (on = newest release incl. pre-release, off = newest stable)
• New: in-app app update (checks GitHub, downloads the new APK, installs it)
• The water circle now appears only while a run is active (clean start screen)
• New: SSR, TUIC, ShadowTLS, AnyTLS and SNIc links are now parsed (note: the official Xray core no longer ships these protocols)
• New: Android 12+ Material You wallpaper color palette support

v1.0.10
• New: XHTTP transport support (type=xhttp links now work)
• New: VLESS post-quantum encryption (mlkem768x25519plus / 0-RTT links now work)
• New: xhttp xPaddingBytes option

v1.0.9
• Security: the signing key password is no longer in the source (now read from an environment variable)
• Fixed: in-app Xray core update — it now installs into the app storage; if the device blocks it, the app opens the releases page so you can install a newer APK
• Fixed: Shadowsocks legacy links whose password contains ":"
• Fixed: a rare progress counter race, stronger free-port search, and disabled app-data backup

v1.0.8
• Log can now be saved as a .txt file (Log button → Save as .txt)
• New iOS lock-screen glass look: frosted panels over a soft gradient background
• Much bigger water circle, now always visible at the top of the screen
• New modern app icon
• Clearer explanations in Settings



v1.0.7
• Dark & Light mode: theme switch (System / Dark / Light) in Settings
• New Settings tab: channel, parallelism, timeout, language and theme moved to their own tab
• New animated water-circle progress: the circle fills with water as the test advances
• Geo check is now parallel over 6 services (was 3 in series) — slow/filtered exits are detected much more often
• Fixed: no more scroll jumps/jitter while a run is in progress



v1.0.6
• Hysteria2: the Hysteria native client is now built in — Salamander and Gecko obfs links now work (the Xray core obfs implementation was broken upstream)
• Hysteria2: fixed parsing of the obfs-password parameter (salamander links now actually get tested)
• Hysteria2: insecure=1 links are tested directly
• Xray logging fixed: Xray 26.x renamed the log file field, so errors are now actually written to the log

v1.0.5
• Bilingual: English / Persian, with a language switch
• Hysteria2: forced classic key exchange (x25519) — the new post-quantum exchange broke the connection
• Hysteria2: SNI is now set automatically
• insecure=1 links: the server certificate is fetched and pinned automatically
• Better Xray logging: exact errors are now written to the log
• Fixed: after a run finishes the app returns to the start state
• Stable signing: future updates install over the previous version (no uninstall needed)

v1.0.3
• allowInsecure fix (removed in new Xray)
• Xray error tail in app log on failure

v1.0.2
• Core moved to jniLibs (exec error=13 fixed)

v1.0.1
• Log button for debugging

v1.0.0
• Initial release
